▽ △

This parameter is used to
• Query the current cancellation status by calling
cancellationHandler.IsCanceled.
Returns true in case, the current conversation has been
cancelled and false otherwise.
• Register a notifier function by calling
cancellationHandler.SetNotifier.
The registered notifier is called if the current conversation is
cancelled.
